label: TrainerBridge BLE
description: Bridges your indoor trainer to your apps (Bestcycling/Garmin/Karoo), correcting the reported power on the fly and inverting the ERG target, and re-exposes it as a virtual power/cadence/speed sensor to the Karoo.
releaseNotes: Bike button presses: pressing - when the trainer is already at its lowest level now reaches the app (before, those presses were ignored and the app's intensity did not go down). When a press and an automatic trainer level change arrive together, the app now receives a single level update instead of two in quick succession.
